title: Rehearse the tenant migration and green Talos environment with real owner wheels

blockers.description: Tenant schema-version mapping: the contract is merged as proposed in vuoro#312 (vuoro docs/architecture/tenant-runtime-schema-mapping.md), but not implemented, so the rehearsal cannot yet assert which work schema each runtime expects.
blockers.resolved_by: vuoro source PR implementing the mapping contract (its acceptance criteria 1-5), by the mapping owner in README owners

why_operator: The Talos environment is cost-bearing (Hetzner) and the plan/apply plus kubeconfig and Talos config stay out of Git on the operator workstation (operator-actions.md section 8).

preconditions.check: Source rehearsal passes against an older baseline
preconditions.command: pg16="$(nix build --no-link --print-out-paths .#postgresql_16)/bin" && VUORO_TEST_POSTGRES_BIN="$pg16" uv run --extra test python scripts/migration_rehearsal.py --previous-ref v0.1.0-poc.75
preconditions.expected: upgrade and fresh install produce the same schema

preconditions.command: git fetch origin && git merge-base --is-ancestor bcc55a9b1321d415e470be558deeb67dabc5b6ed origin/main && echo merged
preconditions.observed: merged: vuoro-cloud#353 fast-forwarded main to bcc55a9 at 2026-11-07T14:20Z

commands.command: Plan terraform/environments/talos as a separate environment and review the saved plan
commands.expected: saved plan with only the green environment's resources

commands.command: Apply the reviewed plan, restore copied databases, reconcile the same workload tree, follow checklists/talos-cutover.md up to but not including DNS cutover
commands.expected: workloads Ready on Talos against copied data; tenant verification passes before READY

expected_result: A green Talos environment running the current tree against copied data, with tenant catalog verification evidence and no DNS change.
send_back: Reconcile status and the tenant verification receipts

rollback.description: Destroy the separate green environment; production is untouched because DNS cutover is a separate approval.
commands: Destroy terraform/environments/talos from the reviewed state
